category: hosted SMS, MMS, RCS and voice API with a time-limited free trial (hosted)

free_tier.stated: 30-day free trial with product-specific free units instead of a dollar balance: 100 SMS messages, 100 WhatsApp messages, 3,000 emails and 75 voice minutes. No credit card at signup. Trial messaging is restricted to verified recipients (up to 5 per account) and to the sign-up country, and requires Twilio-provided message templates.
free_tier.notes: Every SMS or WhatsApp message deducts one free unit; a verification over SMS deducts one SMS unit and one verification unit. The trial expires 30 days after sign-up. A plan help article states 150 free messages with a 10-per-day cap; a restrictions article states a 50-per-day maximum. Those first-party figures conflict with the trials table and are recorded in notes and an open_question.

per_object_cap.stated: An MMS message carries up to 10 media files with a total size of up to 5MB; Twilio rejects messages with over 5MB of media.
per_object_cap.notes: The 5MB is a total across up to 10 attached files, not a single-object cap, so bytes is null. This cap applies to billed MMS messages; the free trial allocates message units, not media storage.

retention.stated: Message bodies and records are kept until the customer requests removal with an HTTP DELETE. Message Logs and the Messages API show records for up to 13 months (400 days) by default, configurable from 7 to 400 days. Records older than 13 months remain accessible through Bulk Export, while MMS media older than 13 months is permanently deleted. Bodies may persist up to 30 days in backups after a DELETE.
retention.notes: 400 days is the default data-access window in the Console and Messages API, not automatic loss: records survive in Bulk Export beyond it, but MMS media older than 13 months is deleted. The value is customer-configurable between 7 and 400 days.

egress.terms: Not a byte-egress offer: messages are sent and read back through the Programmable Messaging REST API and webhooks. Outbound SMS is billed per segment, starting at USD 0.0083 per outbound or inbound segment on a long code (pricing current as of November 2026); no bandwidth egress quota is stated.
egress.free_allowance: 100 free SMS messages in the 30-day trial

interface_detail: The Programmable Messaging REST API serves SMS, MMS, RCS and WhatsApp. The API base URL is https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01 and authentication is HTTP Basic with the API key SID as username and API key secret as password. A separate base URL serves Messaging Services. The Twilio Console and the Message Logs expose the same records.
tooling: The hosted API is reached with the Twilio SDKs (twilio-node, twilio-python and others), with curl against the REST API, or from the Twilio Console. No software the user installs and runs is required: the messaging service is hosted by the vendor. This is a hosted service, not a self-hosted offer.
chaining: Send and receive SMS, MMS, RCS and WhatsApp from an application with delivery-status callbacks, inbound webhooks and message scheduling; combine with Messaging Services and other Twilio products. Hosted service only.

limits.value: 100 SMS messages free in the 30-day trial
trial accounts are restricted to a maximum of 50 messages per day
up to 5 verified recipients per account
MMS media up to 5MB total across up to 10 media files per message
one Twilio number per trial account, at most 3 unique numbers over the account's life
trial calls limited to a maximum of 10 minutes and a maximum of 5 concurrent calls
must use Twilio-provided message templates; custom message bodies are not available during the trial

binding_note: The 100-message, 5-recipient, 30-day trial quota ends free use before the 5MB media cap or the 50-per-day rate is reached; the offer is a trial, not a recurring free tier.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up asks for an email address and a personal phone number, both verified, plus information about the project. The sign-up text states: 'Verify your email address.' and 'Verify your personal phone number.' A free trial account needs no credit card. Trial sending is limited to verified recipients and the sign-up country. The identity needed for a paid account that sends A2P messaging, including adding funds and payment details and carrier registration, is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Trial messages carry a 'Sent from a Twilio Trial account' prefix and trial numbers are shared Twilio-owned numbers that cannot be kept after upgrade. An unused trial number may be removed after 60 days. Message bodies may persist up to 30 days in database backups after an HTTP DELETE request.
confidence_note: All values are quoted from first-party Twilio pricing, documentation and help pages. Sign-up requirements are quoted from the public trial documentation; paid-account identity is unverified behind a sign-up and the trial SMS figures conflict across first-party pages.

notes: First-party pages disagree on the trial SMS allocation and daily cap: the trials table and trial tutorial state 100 SMS messages, a plan help article states 150 messages with a 10-per-day cap, and the trial-restrictions article states a 50-per-day maximum. The trials table is used as the headline value. This offer is a 30-day trial of a hosted messaging API, not a recurring free tier and not self-hosted software.
